chapter: Clubs, publishers, unions and life in Denver
title: Why Horace switched to the organ
summary: Club owners would not pay for bass or a full band, so five men became three and Horace rented a Hammond organ and taught himself, about five or six years before 1975.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Huh. I'm just going to throw some odds and ends kinds of questions to you right now. You said that you're currently playing organ, and I know you have been for a number of years because I can remember hearing you, probably when you first came to Denver, playing at one of the clubs. How long have you been playing organ?
Well, let's see, Tom. I think the last five or six years. In fact, I wasn't too particular about it. It was more or less wished on me. It seemed to have been the trend, you know.
: That's what I was going to ask, whether you did it out of necessity or just because you really liked it.
Well, both -- actually both. I tell you why, because getting back to these nightclub operators again, they didn't want to pay for...

-- (unintelligible) musicians, the bass player. (unintelligible) played the piano. So with the organ you don't, you know. And in fact, I started out with five men, and after talking to some of the nightclub operators about a job, you would have thought I had a symphony.

Five men's a symphony. No, they wouldn't pay. And, of course, that was it, so I just had to cut down, to work steady. I was offered a job, 'If you cut down to three pieces, I'll (unintelligible) contract with options.' Well, anytime you get a flat contract, especially as a feasible figure, well, you're going to try and figure out some way to get a sound out of three, and, of course, I couldn't get it with just piano, drums and saxophone. It would sound horrible.
: Yeah, you need a bass line.
So I first rented an organ, and (unintelligible). The little bit that I play on it was self feel the thing out.

taught. I didn't go to school, but this particular organ was easy to manipulate, and it's worked out real well. (unintelligible). I had trouble with my feet for a long time, and I got so that (unintelligible) after using this one particular organ I brought it home and kept it in this room for a while, for 3 or 4 months, and I got by with it well enough to begin to use it. So it has worked out well for me.
